A1.justification: Both complete PDFs describe MambaQuant and contain matching main sections, Appendices A.1–A.9, seven tables, and thirteen figures. Their text, equations, and visuals support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original quantization accuracy evaluations and rotation ablations in Section 5, with additional results and empirical distribution analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original vision and language evaluations, ablations, and appendix analyses, including the results in Tables 1–7.

M1.justification: Sections 4.2–4.3 retain the same offline KLT-enhanced rotation and online smooth-fused rotation, including S-SiLU and PScan smoothing. No algorithmic component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both evaluate ImageNet, UCF-101, ARC-E, ARC-C, PIQA, Winogrande, and HellaSwag. The appendix calibration-generalization and activation-distribution scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain RTN, GPTQ+RTN, SmoothQuant, and QuaRot. The rotation ablation comparators and appendix ViT/Vim comparison also match; newly cited works are not added experimental baselines.

E3.justification: Both retain the same model variants, W8A8/W4A8 configurations, accuracy metrics, static vision and dynamic language quantization, and calibration procedures. Appendix sample sizes and testing procedures also match.

E4.justification: Section 5.2 retains the same rotation ablations. Appendix studies of variance alignment, computational overhead, calibration generalization, ViT/Vim distributions, and PScan amplification contain the same analyses and evidence.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The unchanged distribution plots describe tensor values rather than uncertainty across experimental runs.

E6.justification: Tables 1–7 and Figures 1–13 retain their results. For example, W8A8 MambaQuant accuracy remains 77.8% for Vim-T† in Table 1 and 62.1% averaged across language tasks for Mamba-2.8b in Table 2.

T1.justification: Equations 1–38 and their mathematical reasoning are unchanged, including the Hadamard variance analysis, Appendix A.3 counterexample, and Appendix A.4 KLT variance-balancing derivation. Reflow across pages does not alter their substance.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same outlier diagnosis, two rotation contributions, first comprehensive Mamba PTQ framework claim, and less-than-1% accuracy-loss claim for 8-bit quantization.

C2.justification: The explanations of variance alignment and PScan amplification are unchanged. Appendix A.1 retains the limitations concerning 4-bit accuracy and online KLT computational cost; A.7 retains the same generalization qualifications.

D1.justification: Implementation and calibration descriptions, Appendix A.5 overhead calculations, and the linked code repository are unchanged. No technical or resource-access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds four background citations and corresponding references: Krizhevsky et al. (2012), Yang et al. (2024), Zhou et al. (2024), and Yue et al. (2024). The research positioning and novelty claims remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 adds the ICLR 2025 publication header and removes Sifan Zhou's corresponding-author marker. Apart from citation insertions, the prose and section organization remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 adds conference headers and page numbers, with limited layout reflow around references and appendix equations. All thirteen figure images are identical, and the seven tables retain their structures and captions.

improvement.justification: The added background citations slightly expand attribution, and conference formatting updates presentation. However, the methods, results, proofs, explanations, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices, yielding no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
